scope: Same three V19 waiting roots, fitted trip laws, MCT, deadlines, ideal public actual-second platform contract and fixed publication. No new actual dates, no retuning.
primary: direct_zero uses the V19 nominal and support screens in the original order, then keeps every extra path on a single trip. Preserve original A/B paths and their V19 semantics. Score direct paths with the existing backward contraction. Apply zero margin to both current and projected future offers, retaining exact physical clocks and score interpolation.
paired_worlds: 1024 per root, four independent blocks of 256 at [20261120,int(date),query,decision,block]. Fixed root+30-second publication if measured construction and binding fit. Rotate replay order. No extension of this tape.
checks: Compare retained paths, wait IDs, departure supports and scores to the full V19 compiler. On any world where V19 keeps an A/B or a through path, require direct_zero to match both first ride and loss. Attribute all changed outcomes to removed extra transfers.
cost: Each arm starts from a separate preparation of the same frozen model. Charge cold screening, scores and controller setup, binding, incumbent setup, action and applicability. Publish after the common artificial hold without charging that hold as wall computation. Shared fitting, oracle and simulation are evaluation costs.
gate: Primary only. Apply the V19 one-sided complement-product bound to policy-minus-full-graph-hindsight with alpha .05/3 for simultaneous root coverage. Report same-tape paired travel differences and the ratio of mean gains over first_visible descriptively. Full G2 still requires optimized generic planning under the same public contract and a methodological increment.
